title_sq: APARTAMENT PREMIUM 3+1 PER SHITJE PRANE LIQENIT
description_sq:
Ofrojme per shitje nje apartament premium ne nje nga godinat me te mira ne zone me nje pamje panormike te Liqenit.
Apartamenti ka planimetri shume te rregullt ne nje lartesi 3.2m dhe organizohen ne:
- Ambinet ndenje,
- Kuzhine gatimi e vecuar,
- Tre dhoma gjumi,
- Dy tualete dhe
- Verande perimetrike me pamje totalisht te lire te Liqenit te Tiranes ku kane akses te gjitha ambiente e apartamentit.
Gjitheashtu ofrohet mundesia per te blere poste parkimi.
Pallati eshte shume i mirembajtur dhe me komunitet te mire.
Per me shume infomacione ju ftoj te na kontaktoni SUN128840
title_en: PREMIUM 3+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE NEAR THE LAKE
description_en: We offer for sale a premium apartment in one of the best buildings in the area with a panoramic view of the lake. The apartment has a very regular floor plan at a height of 3.2m and is organized in: - Living room, - Separate kitchen, - Three bedrooms, - Two toilets and - Perimeter veranda with a totally free view of the Lake of Tirana where all the premises of the apartment have access. It is also possible to buy a parking spot. The palace is very well maintained and has a good community. For more information, I invite you to contact us at SUN128840
